explanation: Pointing directly at someone with a single index finger is widely described as impolite across Arab countries, including Saudi Arabia, because it can read as accusatory. Saudis typically gesture with the whole hand, consistent with the broader custom of using both hands together to offer or indicate things rather than a single finger.
local_tip: Gesture with your whole hand, palm open, rather than pointing with a single finger.

also_check.note: Pointing with a single finger is impolite; gesturing with the whole hand is preferred.
Single-finger pointing is tolerated informally but seen as impolite in more formal settings.
Pointing with the index finger is common and mostly unremarkable in casual contexts.

sources.title: Common Gestures People Use in Arab Countries
